summary: The Assessment system is a comprehensive tool designed to manage and facilitate placement request assessments primarily in an educational context.
purpose: The main purpose of the system is to handle assessment-related operations, including capturing and processing student assessment data, managing workflow through a wizard interface, and providing tools for validation, reporting, and submission.

workflows.name: Assessment Submission Workflow
steps: Set up the wizard interface with steps corresponding to each section of the assessment.
Initialize assessment header and populate questions.
Capture responses based on input type (text, number, date, checkbox, dropdown).
Perform validation checks on responses to ensure data integrity.
Submit assessment if all required fields are completed.
Generate reports based on assessment data.
Provide options for unlocking and re-submitting assessments if necessary.

business_rules: Assessments are processed based on templates identified by a template code.
Interim and final assessments are handled distinctly with separate IDs and processes.
Assessment steps are set up according to the assessor type and assessment type.
validations: Ensure assessments sum up to 100% using 'addTo100' validation.
Language-based validations ensuring text conforms to locale-specific requirements.
Specific choice validation for checkboxes and text inputs to ensure correct specifications are entered.
calculations: Dynamic calculation for dropdowns based on previous selections.
conditions: Assessment sections are displayed based on whether they are required or optional.
Responses are processed only if they match the defined structure and types.
system_behavior: Auto-save functionality persists user progress without manual input.
Assessment data is displayed in a wizard interface, allowing navigation between steps.
Validation errors are displayed dynamically, and corrective actions are provided.
dependencies: Requires a session object for user-specific data and actions.
Interacts with a backend service for assessment-related operations.
exceptions: Error if assessment data fails to load or save due to incorrect formatting.
Validation failures when the input does not meet specified criteria.
